name: v13_revenue_news_reversal_margin
hypothesis: Positive Ravenpack revenue-event sentiment can identify firms with improving demand perception. Mix with gross margin and a small intraday reversal component.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_ess_revenue, 60), industry) + 0.25 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / sales, 126), subindustry)
notes: Ravenpack revenue news, distinct from existing mean earnings-evaluation sentiment; strict correlation gate against RRpmOAWj.

name: v13_earnings_news_cash_quality
hypothesis: Earnings news impact can be more reliable when backed by operating cash flow. Use fundamental cashflow_op rather than analyst CFO.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 60), industry) + 0.25 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry)
notes: Tests Ravenpack earnings impact, but may correlate with existing news/reversal ACTIVE.

name: v13_cash_liquidity_quality
hypothesis: Cash and short-term investments relative to current liabilities can proxy liquidity safety. Pair with operating quality and small reversal.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(cash_st / liabilities_curr, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Safety branch distinct from previous low-debt/systematic-risk tests.

name: v13_current_ratio_cashflow
hypothesis: A stronger current ratio backed by operating cash flow may indicate balance-sheet resilience without relying on receivables or deferred revenue.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(assets_curr / liabilities_curr, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Current-ratio safety; watch correlation with cash-liquidity candidate.

name: v13_low_goodwill_cash_quality
hypothesis: Lower goodwill relative to assets can reduce acquisition-accounting and impairment risk. Pair with cash-flow quality and a small reversal stabilizer.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * goodwill / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Goodwill/intangible burden is a new balance-sheet-quality mechanism.

name: v13_intangible_light_margin
hypothesis: Lower intangible-asset burden combined with stronger gross margin may capture cleaner capital structure and operating quality.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fnd6_intan / assets, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Sibling to goodwill burden but uses total intangible assets and gross margin.

name: v13_rd_intensity_growth
hypothesis: R&D intensity can proxy innovation when sales growth is positive. This tests innovation quality rather than treating R&D purely as a burden.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(rd_expense / sales, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales_growth, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Previous R&D burden was weak; this tests the positive innovation-intensity sign.

name: v13_negative_analyst_revision_derivative
hypothesis: Earlier model rank-derivative fields failed in the positive direction. Test the negative sign for analyst-revision derivative with quality/reversal stabilizers.
expression: 0.55 * rank(-1 * analyst_revision_rank_derivative) + 0.25 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry)
notes: Low priority exploratory model branch; keep strict metrics and correlation gates.
